gloss: to retake; to reshoot; to take again

definitions.gloss: to retake; to reshoot; to photograph again
definitions.explanation: To take a photo or shoot a video again, usually because the first attempt was unsatisfactory.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}り{直|なお}した。
ぶれていたので、もう{一枚|いちまい}{撮|と}り{直|なお}してもらえますか。
examples.english: It was blurry, so could you retake it?

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}は{納得|なっとく}がいかず、そのシーンを{何度|なんど}も{撮|と}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: The director wasn't satisfied and reshot that scene many times.

notes:
Compound verb from {撮|と}る (to take/photograph) + {直|なお}す (to redo; to fix). The {直|なお}す auxiliary pattern is productive: {書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite), {作|つく}り{直|なお}す (remake), やり{直|なお}す (redo). Very common in everyday situations — asking someone to retake a group photo, reshooting scenes for film, or retaking an ID photo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to retake a photo
- シーンを{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to reshoot a scene
- {証明|しょうめい}{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}り{直|なお}す: to retake an ID photo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}する: to reshoot — more formal; used in professional photography and film production
- {撮|と}る: to take (a photo) — the base verb, without the "again" nuance
